default_packaging_structure.stage_gate: Load this effect specification only after material readiness. Public still collection and user recording happen before packaging. Lock packaging before editing, animation, preview, or rendering; each production action still needs its own authorization.
required_outputs: 04-动效与包装/需要补录的操作素材-<slug>.md
04-动效与包装/工具官网-GitHub截图素材表-<slug>.md

required_cues.use: Flip into the new small chapter title and leave a readable hold.
Assemble a tool card; place a public landing page, GitHub home, or official logo in the right frame.
Connect named steps in a readable parameter/spacing chain.
Full-screen real brand lockup, adapted from the card's outro role.
Pause or hold the opening, then bridge with the card-flock motion, approved music, and the real brand mark.

optional_cues.use: Tour a real public product-page screenshot near the first product-name mention.
Transparent or masked keyword overlay that leaves the person visible.
Transparent or masked layer behind the person; default copy is 人物、字幕、信息、画面和这些动效.
Transparent or masked keyword depth layer behind the person.
Reveal exact supplied text in a readable document layout.
Drop and settle a real UI card group, then stop for reading.
Reveal a real UI from sketch or skeleton to content; keep layouts congruent.

production_chain: video-use owns the verified transcript, editorial timing, source-to-master mapping, speaker states, captions, and insertions.
video-shotcraft supplies the validated card, style-key, complete card guidance, and exact demo implementation.
Remotion composes approved source, speaker/matte, background, effect, material, caption, music, and SFX tracks.
default_packaging_structure.implementation_prerequisite: Create 02-转录与剪辑决策/导演时间线-<slug>.json from the director timeline schema. A proportional transcript estimate is planning-only and cannot drive an implementation preview.
default_packaging_structure.verification: For every selected card, validate card and style-key in the installed Shotcraft Gallery, read the full card and exact reference demo TSX, and adapt the motion to the current project. If the user requests the approved Episode 5 opening language, read and reuse its component baseline instead of rewriting a same-name approximation.

shot_library.name: video-shotcraft
usage_contract: Validate the card name and style-key in gallery/api/library.json.
Read the complete references/shots card and the exact demo TSX named by its reference implementation.
Reuse motion structure, rhythm, and implementation patterns; do not use Gallery preview media as project footage.
Adapt copy, fonts, colors, screenshots, recordings, and talking-head footage to the current project.
Preserve the source license and attribution requirements.

title_background.description: low-contrast black and gray animated technology perspective grid

code_prompt_panel.layout: large readable panel on the left or center, talking-head PIP in a safe right-side area
code_prompt_panel.body_font: monospace for code and commands; readable UI sans-serif for prose prompts and Chinese instructions
content_policy: Use the exact source text supplied by the script or project material; never invent or silently rewrite copyable content.
Preserve indentation, line breaks, punctuation, capitalization, flags, and placeholders.
Wrap at semantic boundaries and never reduce the type until it becomes hard to read.
Use one static page for up to 8 lines, 2-3 paged semantic blocks for 9-16 lines, and a key excerpt plus an explicitly approved full-text destination for longer content.
Highlight only the line or phrase currently being spoken; keep the rest stable.
Reserve a caption-safe band and never place captions over copyable text.

states.main: technology grid with animated title or keyword

states.talking_head: bottom-right PIP or another safe corner

states.main: large readable code or prompt panel with an optional type label, concise title, and copy cue
states.talking_head: right-side PIP or another safe area that does not reduce panel readability
bottom-right PIP or hidden when content requires it

clean_jump_cut_allowed_for: mistake removal within the same state
pause removal within the same state
transition_policy.align_to: spoken semantic cue or sentence boundary

custom_layout_transitions.action: Keep the same clip and audio while animating scale, position, crop, corner radius, border, and shadow into the safe corner.
Reverse the PIP transform after the material or title clears; do not restart the speaker clip.

opening_recipe.cue: hook or first reveal of the central object
opening_recipe.adaptation: Replace the demo card with the current project's main screenshot, cover, or concept card.

opening_recipe.cue: spoken key capability, field, or decisive phrase
opening_recipe.adaptation: Highlight only the exact phrase being spoken.

opening_recipe.cue: move from the hook into the explanation state
opening_recipe.adaptation: Place the talking-head video inside the moving frame and settle it into the bottom-right PIP.

transitions.use: short emphasis, rapid same-topic switch, or return to the speaker
send, share, handoff, or message transfer
reveal a complete screen, desk, document, or material
multiple screenshots, multiple stages, or overview-to-detail
carry a border, path, or highlight into the next scene
fast operation or high-energy result reveal; never during a reading segment

titles_and_product_names.use: product name, central proposition, or chapter card
search, filter, keyword input, and result narrowing
multiple cards, outcomes, or collected items

screen_ui_and_process.use: AI conclusion first, evidence rows second, completed state last
parameter, spacing, layout, or numeric adjustment
voice input, dictation, live typing, or prompt entry
move generated rows or panel content onto an open canvas

code_prompt_and_instruction.use: short prompt entry or a compact instruction being entered; settle to a static readable panel immediately after entry
highlight the exact code line, flag, placeholder, or prompt phrase currently named in speech
draw the panel boundary into the scene or carry the active line into the next visual state

closing_and_return.use: wake the current panel, complete the explanation, then let it sleep before returning to the speaker

compositions.rule: Finish the cursor dialogue and handoff before materializing content; do not run both primary actions during the same reading moment.

selection_algorithm: Finish transcript-based mistake and pause removal before motion timing.
Mark the spoken semantic cues for names, claims, demonstrations, evidence, exact code or prompts, collaboration, and returns to the speaker.
Extract copyable code, prompts, commands, and instructions exactly from the script or approved project material before designing their panels.
Assign one of the five visual states to every segment.
Assign a transition to every state change and a clean jump cut only to same-state speech cleanup.
Choose one primary effect whose meaning matches the spoken cue; do not repeat an effect back-to-back.
Keep recordings and screenshots fullscreen and readable, with the speaker in a safe-corner PIP.
Write captions on the main composition and resolve PIP/UI conflicts before previewing.
Write the effect map and director storyboard before producing a preview.
